step1_figure.circuit_type: Folded-cascode op-amp with class AB output buffer and gain-enhancement
step1_figure.description: A high-gain two-stage operational amplifier utilizing gain-enhancement (GE) in the folded-cascode first stage to boost the output resistance and overall DC open-loop gain. The provided netlist is configured as a unity-gain voltage follower (Vout tied to the inverting input).

gain_enhancement_amp_gain.description: Gain of the auxiliary differential amplifiers used for gain enhancement.

equation.explanation: The intrinsic gain of the auxiliary amplifiers regulating the cascode nodes.
equation.assumptions: Assumes symmetric N and P auxiliary amplifiers.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias current and channel lengths of the auxiliary amplifiers.

open_loop_gain_no_ge.description: Low-frequency open-loop gain of the op-amp without gain enhancement.

equation.explanation: The product of the first stage (folded cascode) gain and the second stage (class AB) gain.
equation.assumptions: Assumes standard output resistance without the GE regulation.

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage gain ≈ g_m * R_out ≈ 200uS * 200kΩ = 40 V/V. Second stage gain ≈ 10 V/V. Total ≈ 400 V/V (52 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Intrinsic gain (g_m * r_o) in SKY130 is typically 20-50 for minimum length devices.

open_loop_gain_with_ge.description: Total low-frequency open-loop gain of the op-amp with gain enhancement.

equation.explanation: The original open-loop gain multiplied by the gain of the enhancement amplifiers.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the GE amplifiers perfectly regulate the cascode nodes at DC.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The GE technique boosts the output resistance of the first stage by A_GE, directly multiplying the total gain.

ge_amp_freq_response.description: Frequency response of the added GE amplifiers.

equation.explanation: Single-pole roll-off model for the auxiliary GE amplifiers.
equation.assumptions: Assumes a dominant pole f_3dBGE in the auxiliary amplifiers.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dBGE depends on C_cGE (240fF). f_3dBGE ≈ 1 / (2π * 100kΩ * 240fF) ≈ 6.6 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the output resistance of the GE amp and its compensation capacitor.

total_open_loop_freq_response.description: Frequency response of the entire op-amp with GE.

equation.formula: A_0LGE(f) = (A_0LDC / (1 + j * f / f_3dB)) * (A_GEDC / (1 + j * f / f_3dBGE))
equation.explanation: Combines the frequency response of the main op-amp and the GE amplifiers, showing a potential doublet.
equation.assumptions: Assumes independent single-pole responses that multiply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pole-zero doublet occurs if f_3dBGE doesn't perfectly cancel. Not a single scalar value.
sky130_expected.reasoning: This is a transfer function, not a single metric.

dominant_pole_with_ge.description: Dominant pole frequency of the folded-cascode OTA with GE.

equation.explanation: The dominant pole is pushed to a lower frequency due to the increased output resistance from GE.
equation.assumptions: Assumes C_c is the dominant capacitance.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The high DC gain results in a very low dominant pole frequency.

ideal_regulated_voltage.description: Ideal output voltage of a voltage regulator application.

equation.explanation: The output voltage set by the resistor divider in a non-inverting configuration.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends entirely on external components and reference.

finite_gain_regulated_voltage.description: Actual regulated voltage considering finite open-loop gain.

equation.explanation: Shows the gain error introduced by finite A_0L.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High gain from GE makes the error very small.

min_gate_voltage_m7.description: Minimum voltage swing on the gate of the pass transistor in a regulator.

equation.explanation: The lowest voltage the op-amp output can drive before the input differential pair drops out of saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the threshold voltage of the NMOS input pair.

two_stage_opamp_gain.description: Open-loop gain of a standard two-stage op-amp (used in regulator example).

equation.explanation: Product of the gains of the two stages.

closed_loop_output_resistance.description: Output resistance of the op-amp in closed-loop.

equation.explanation: The open-loop output resistance divided by the loop gain.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High open-loop gain drastically reduces closed-loop output resistance.

output_pole_f2.description: Location of the output pole in the regulator.

equation.explanation: The pole formed by the closed-loop output resistance and the load capacitance.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance.

first_stage_pole_f1.description: Location of the pole at the output of the first stage.

equation.explanation: Pole formed by the first stage output resistance and the gate capacitance of the second stage.
equation.assumptions: Assumes C_gs7 dominates the node capacitance.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the size of the pass transistor (M7).

unity_gain_freq_regulator.description: Unity-gain frequency of the regulator loop.

equation.formula: f_un = A_0LDC * f_2 = A_0LDC^2 / (2π * R_2 * C_Lmin * A_CL)
equation.explanation: The frequency where the loop gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_un ≈ 100 MHz for the GE op-amp.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text states 400MHz for 50nm, SKY130 might be slightly slower depending on bias.

min_load_capacitance.description: Minimum load capacitance required for stability in the regulator.

equation.formula: C_Lmin = ((g_m1 * R_1 * g_m2)^2 * R_2) / (2π * f_un * A_CL)
equation.explanation: The minimum C_L needed to push the output pole low enough to compensate the loop.
equation.assumptions: Assumes load capacitance is used for compensation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on specific regulator design, typically in the nF range for off-chip caps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large capacitance is needed to make the output pole dominant.

output_swing_limit.description: Minimum output voltage to keep the output stage in saturation.

equation.explanation: The condition for the bottom transistor of the push-pull stage to remain in saturation.
equation.assumptions: Assumes a specific bad biasing scheme discussed in the text.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limits the downward swing of the output.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the closed-loop bandwidth (approx unity-gain frequency), step response (overshoot, rise time), and power consumption of the GE op-amp configured as a voltage follower.
